new_jobs.description:
Responsibilities

MaxLinear is seeking a high energy and experienced Senior Engineering Program Manager for this high-visibility role leading the full project lifecycle of engineering R&D programs including planning, tracking, and execution. In this role, you will focus on:

Lead planning, tracking, and execution of R&D programs at corporate headquarters through close collaboration with cross-functional engineering leads and senior management
Develop detailed staffing plan and bottom-up schedule for R&D programs that involve RF/AMS, DSP algorithms, SOC, Software, System and System Integration and Test teams
Establish program Plan of Record and success metrics and track continuously
Manage program execution to ensure product leadership, while meeting quality, timeline, and cost requirements; manage execution risks by implementing mitigation strategies and contingency plans
Report on program status, issues, and action plans to business unit program management and to senior management
Ensure program adherence to MaxLinear’s Process Development Methodology and assure project lifecycle compliance, including reviews and lessons learned sessions, and continuous improvements in processes, cross-functional development flows, and execution excellence
Manage relationships with all program stakeholders, suppliers, and customers to optimize outcomes

Qualifications

Knowledge and broad experience across technical disciplines including: RF/AMS, DSP, SoC, Systems, Software, and System Integration and Test
Deep expertise in one or more of these areas:
Track record of hands-on technical program / project management or engineering chip lead experience over multiple product cycles
In-depth understanding of engineering workflows, validation methodologies, and processes
Exposure to chip bring up, debug, system integration and lab validation

Creative problem solver with execution mindset, ability to excel and lead cross-functional technical teams to deliver to plans of record
Self-motivated with excellent communication skills
BS + 11 years of experience, MS + 9 years of experience or equivalent, or Ph.D. + 6 years of experience

Compensation And Benefits

MaxLinear has a Total Compensation philosophy which includes base salary and annual discretionary bonus eligibility and many positions also include stock-based compensation.

MaxLinear's good faith estimate starting base salary range is: $168,000 to $208,000 Annually

We offer competitive benefits designed to support employee health, welfare, and retirement and some highlights are: health care benefits, 401k savings plan, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), and paid time off.

The actual starting base salary will be determined by the match to certain role-related criteria such as educational degree(s) or equivalent, relevant work experience, skillset needed for the role, and geographic location; this is not an all-inclusive list as some roles may require unique skills or experience.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, and will not be discriminated against based on race, sex, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status.

Company Overview

MaxLinear is a global, NASDAQ-traded company (MXL) where the entrepreneurial spirit is alive and well. We are a fabless system-on-chip product company, striving to improve the world’s communication networks for everyone through our highly integrated radio-frequency (RF), analog, digital, and mixed-signal semiconductor solutions for access and connectivity, wired and wireless infrastructure, and industrial and multi-market applications.

We hire the best people in the industry and engage them in some of the most exciting opportunities that connect the world we live in today. Our growth has come from innovative, bold approaches to solving some of the world’s most challenging communication technology problems in the most efficient and effective manner.

MaxLinear began by developing the world’s first high-performance TV tuner chip using standard CMOS process technology. Others said we couldn’t achieve the extremely high-performance requirements using CMOS, but we proved them wrong and achieved enduring global market leadership with our designs. Since then, we’ve developed a full line of products that drive 4G and 5G infrastructure; enable data center, metro and long-haul optical interconnects; bring 10Gbit to the home; power the IoT revolution; and enable robust and reliable communication in harsh industrial environments. Over the years, we’ve expanded through organic growth and through several acquisitions that have perfectly complemented our existing portfolio and enabled us to deliver complete end-to-end solutions in our target markets. One such example was the acquisition of Intel’s Home Gateway Platform Division that added Wi-Fi, Ethernet, and Broadband Gateway Processor SoC technology to our connected home portfolio creating a complete and scalable platform of connectivity and access solutions to fully address our customers’ needs.

Our headquarters are in Carlsbad, near San Diego, California. We also have major design centers in Irvine and San Jose, California; Valencia, Spain; Bangalore, India; Munich, Germany; Israel; and Singapore.

We have approximately 1,200 employees, a substantial majority of whom have engineering degrees and include masters and Ph.D. graduates from many of the premiere universities around the world. Our employees thrive on innovation, outstanding execution, outside-the-box thinking, nimbleness, and collaboration. Together, we form a high-energy business team that is focused on building the best and most innovative products on the market.

Shield supports research activities involving controlled unclassified information (CUI) that Georgia Tech conducts on behalf of the Department of War (DOW) and other U.S. Government sponsors. GT Shield is certified at CMMC Level 2 following a third-party (C3PAO) assessment, meeting all NIST SP 800-171 requirements.

Job Summary

The successful candidate will have the opportunity to shape the expansion of Shield to the Georgia Tech research enterprise, including laboratory environments that conduct cutting-edge research on a broad range of topics.

The successful candidate will bring deep experience with CMMC, NIST SP 800-171, and building, transforming, or materially improving programs operating in complex regulated environments and will be expected to operate as a trusted advisor to cybersecurity leadership and institutional stakeholders.

This position offers a unique opportunity to shape the trajectory of CMMC-compliant research at one of the worlds leading research universities. The role provides broad visibility across the Institute's research enterprise, significant autonomy, and the ability to shape and expand CMMC-compliant research practices at Georgia Tech.

Georgia Tech is a top-ranked public research university situated in the heart of Atlanta, a diverse and vibrant city with significant economic and cultural strengths. The Institute serves more than 45,000 students through top-ranked undergraduate, graduate, and executive programs in engineering, computing, science, business, design, and liberal arts. Georgia Tech's faculty attracted more than $1.4 billion in research awards this past year in fields ranging from biomedical technology to artificial intelligence, energy, sustainability, semiconductors, neuroscience, and national security. Georgia Tech ranks among the nation¿s top 20 universities for research and development spending and No. 1 among institutions without a medical school.

Responsibilities

Job Duty 1 -

Lead project teams through planning, assigning and overseeing diverse activities; define project goals, objectives, scope and estimates of schedules, resources and costs involving multiple projects being conducted simultaneously.

Job Duty 2 -

Direct project execution through continual coordination of planning, tasking, performance reporting, change control and issue management.

Job Duty 6 -

Develop and manage project budgets.

Job Duty 7 -

Manage acquisition of project related goods and contract services.

Job Duty 8 -

Provide mentoring, training and career guidance for team members.

Job Duty 9 -

Perform other duties as assigned

Responsibilities

The CMMC IT Project Manager will:

Drive and shape the expansion of the Shield research service into the Georgia Tech research enterprise while maintaining CMMC and NIST 800-171 compliance.
Develop and mature a scalable compliance-assurance framework for laboratories, instrumentation, and research computing environments, including documentation standards, assessment processes, designated local compliance representatives, cybersecurity review workflows, and mechanisms for maintaining ongoing compliance.
Engage with researchers and translate their requirements into practical and CMMC-compliant solutions that integrate Shield, laboratory, instrumentation, HPC, and other research computing resources to meet their needs.
Find innovative solutions that enable research across Shield, laboratory, computational, and specialized research environments while maintaining CMMC and NIST SP 800-171 compliance.
Develop repeatable processes for assessing, integrating, and maintaining the compliance of laboratories, instrumentation, computing resources, and research support services involved in CMMC and CUI research activities. Oversee control framework management, evidence standards, assessment approaches, and issue remediation governance.
Shape preparations for CMMC third-party (C3PAO) assessments of CMMC compliance in Georgia Tech's laboratory and HPC environments.
Translate complex cybersecurity, regulatory, and technology risk issues into clear business terms for senior leaders, decision-makers, and non-technical stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience

Custom Fireplace Patio & BBQ is an outdoor living store based in Pleasanton, Ca. We have been in the industry since 1972, specializing in high end outdoor kitchens, fireplaces, and everything outdoor.

We're hiring a Field Project Manager to lead our installation team and own the technical side of the installations. Bamboo Health is the leader in Real-Time Care Intelligence™ solutions aimed at improving lives for everyone experiencing physical and behavioral health challenges. We are driven by our mission to empower clients to deliver seamless, high-quality and cost-effective care during pivotal moments to improve health outcomes. From coast to coast, Bamboo Health partners with all major retail pharmacy chains, 52 states and territories, 100% of the top 10 best hospitals and more than half of the country’s largest health plans to improve more than 1 billion patient encounters annually. Join us in improving lives during pivotal care moments!

Summary

Bamboo Health is building a team of compassionate clinicians and leaders who are committed to improving care access to those in most need. We are seeking a seasoned, highly motivated Senior Project Manager who can bridge clinical, operational, and technical workstreams across provider and payor organizations. This role owns end-to-end project delivery—from initial scoping through go-live and post-launch stabilization—while consulting directly with customers on workflow design to drive results and accelerate implementation timelines. In addition to leading individual implementations, you will manage a portfolio of partner engagements, balancing competing priorities, risks, and stakeholder needs while helping scale implementation best practices across the organization. The ideal candidate brings a strong mix of project management and client success experience, deep healthcare delivery knowledge, and the judgment to work independently with minimal oversight, comfortably tailoring communication across a variety of stakeholders and cross-functional teams.

What You’ll Do

Own the full implementation lifecycle for new provider or payor partners, working independently and with minimal oversight to ensure all milestones, deliverables, and outcomes are met on time and within scope.
Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for external partners, including health systems, provider networks, and payors.
Partner with customers and internal clinical and operational teams to design workflows, staffing models, referral pathways, and escalation processes that support successful implementation and accelerate time to value.
Collaborate with data integration and IT teams to enable connectivity with EHRs, care management platforms, and analytics tools.
Guide partners through workflow changes, training, and adoption planning to drive results and ensure smooth go-live transitions.
Maintain project plans and status reports, as well as risks and issues logs.
Tailor communication of progress, dependencies, and mitigation plans across audiences, from junior project managers to executive leadership, both internally and externally.
Capture lessons learned and feedback to refine implementation methodology, mentor less experienced project managers, and accelerate future rollouts.
Manage a portfolio of concurrent implementations, balancing timelines, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder priorities to ensure successful delivery.
Identify repetitive tasks and partner with team leads to implement scalable automation solutions.

What Success Looks Like…

In 3 months…

Take ownership of at least one active implementation, serving as the primary customer contact while maintaining accurate status reporting, risk management, and stakeholder communication.
Build strong relationships with key internal and external stakeholders and identify opportunities to improve workflows, processes, or implementation efficiency.
Identify at least one opportunity in your role to pilot or apply AI or automation (e.g., streamlining a task, summarizing data, generating content).

In 6 months…

Independently manage a portfolio of concurrent implementations, consistently delivering key milestones on time and within scope.
Lead partners through workflow design, operational readiness, training, adoption planning, and go-live execution.
Serve as a trusted advisor to customers while mentoring less experienced project managers and contributing implementation best practices across the team.

In 12 months…

Deliver multiple successful go-lives with measurable post-launch stabilization, such as partner adoption targets met and time to value shortened compared with baseline.
Capture lessons learned across your implementations and contribute at least two lasting improvements to our implementation playbook, templates, or tools.
Be recognized as a go-to leader for complex implementations, influencing customer outcomes, supporting executive-level partner relationships, and helping elevate implementation excellence across the organization.

What You Need

Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of combined experience in healthcare project management and account/client success, preferably with exposure to behavioral health, care coordination, or population health in technology enabled services.
Proven success independently leading complex implementations or partnerships involving provider organizations, payors, or health IT vendors, with minimal oversight.
Experience with EHR integrations, referral management workflows, or value-based care initiatives strongly preferred.
A consultative, proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with strong attention to detail.
Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity, solve complex problems, and independently drive projects forward in dynamic environments.
Strongly empathetic with a keen desire to reduce barriers to behavioral health and social services for the underserved.
Ability to convey technical information and tailor communication across a range of audiences and levels, from junior project managers to clinicians, administrators, and C-level executives, exercising strong, independent judgment in what and how to communicate with customers.
PMP (Project Management Professional, PMI) is preferred.
Comfort using or learning AI-supported tools (e.g., ChatGPT, CoPilot, or role-specific tools) to improve daily workflows.
A forward-thinking, curious mindset with an openness to experimenting with new technologies.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with sound judgment and creativity in designing solutions.
Proven ability to thrive in fast-paced, high-growth, and rapidly evolving environments.
Ability to work effectively in a remote-first environment, ensuring high-quality virtual interactions with minimal distractions.
The ability to travel periodically for work.

What You Get

Join one of the most innovative healthcare technology companies in the country.
Have the autonomy to build something with an enthusiastically supportive team.
Learn from working at the highest levels and on the most strategic priorities of the company, including from world class investors and advisors.
Receive competitive compensation, including health, dental, vision and other benefits.

Belonging at Bamboo

We Care. #BambooHealthValuesCare

Every human being has the right to the best possible healthcare. Our Real-Time Care Intelligence™ solutions enable healthcare professionals to see and treat every individual as a whole person by providing the right information, at the right time – regardless of physical, behavioral or social barriers.

We’re a great place to work because we care. We continually seek to learn about our differences and ensure the unique perspectives and contributions of all employees are welcome, valued and celebrated.

PMO Business Intelligence & Project Performance Analyst

This position may be based in Birmingham, Alabama, or at an SNC nuclear plant—Farley, Hatch, or Vogtle.

Job Summary

Southern Nuclear Operating Company (SNC) operates one of the nation's most respected nuclear generating fleets. The Project Management Office (PMO) provides fleet-level governance, project oversight, performance management, and reporting to support informed decision-making across the enterprise.

The PMO Business Intelligence & Project Performance Analyst develops reporting solutions, dashboards, scorecards, and analytics that provide visibility into project and portfolio performance. Partnering with project management, project controls, finance, engineering, information technology, and site leadership, this role improves data reliability, reporting efficiency, and decision quality by defining meaningful performance measures, identifying trends and risks, and translating complex cost, schedule, financial, resource, and strategic investment data into actionable insights.

Job Requirements

Education

Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline is required.
Advanced degree or relevant certification, such as Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst, Certified Analytics Professional, PMP, or PMI-PBA, is preferred.

Experience

At least five years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, financial analysis, performance reporting, or a related discipline is required.
Experience in project controls or project management, particularly within large-scale project organizations, project portfolios, capital programs, or complex multidisciplinary project environments, is a plus.
Experience developing Power BI dashboards, executive scorecards, data visualizations, KPIs, and automated reporting solutions is required.
Experience analyzing project cost, schedule, forecast, earned value, risk, resource utilization, and portfolio performance data is preferred.
Experience consolidating and validating data from multiple projects, sites, business units, or enterprise systems is preferred.
Experience with Power BI and Microsoft Excel is required. Experience with SharePoint, Primavera P6, SAP, Microsoft Project, SQL, or comparable project reporting and data platforms is a plus.
Experience supporting a PMO, Finance, or enterprise reporting organization is a plus.
Experience in a utility environment, including nuclear, electric generation, transmission, distribution, or related infrastructure, is a plus.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Advanced proficiency with Power BI, including data modeling, DAX, Power Query, report development, and dashboard design.
Advanced Excel skills and working knowledge of data integration, validation, governance, and reporting controls.
Familiarity with project management and project controls concepts, including project lifecycle management, stage-gate processes, governance, portfolio management, budgeting, forecasting, integrated scheduling, change control, risk management, earned value, and performance measurement.
Ability to translate business requirements into clear report specifications, metric definitions, data models, dashboards, and acceptance criteria.
Ability to interpret performance data, identify trends and root causes, and provide actionable recommendations.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and handle sensitive information appropriately.
Ability to travel among SNC sites and maintain unescorted access to SNC facilities.

Primary Responsibilities

Develop, maintain, and enhance Power BI dashboards, executive scorecards, KPIs, and project performance reports.
Analyze project and portfolio performance across cost, schedule, forecast, risk, resource utilization, earned value, and financial results.
Develop analytical insights and forecasting information that support executive decision-making, portfolio health assessments, and project prioritization.
Validate and reconcile data; document metric logic, data lineage, and business rules; and ensure reporting accuracy and traceability.
Partner with business and technical stakeholders to gather and define reporting requirements, data ownership, validation controls, and acceptance criteria.
Automate reporting processes to reduce manual effort and improve consistency, reliability, and efficiency.
Prepare executive-level reports, presentations, analytical summaries, and recommendations for leadership.
Support PMO governance metrics and reporting for project reviews, portfolio reviews, monthly reporting cycles, organizational performance management, data governance, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Evaluate emerging analytics, automation, and artificial intelligence capabilities that improve reporting efficiency, data reliability, and project performance visibility.

Demonstrates Our Values: Safety First, Unquestionable Trust, Superior Performance, and Total Commitment.

We are the platform turning browsing into shopping
. We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands.

We help consumers save time and money while making smart shopping decisions, and we support retailers and brands in engaging customers from online research to in-store purchases.

In 2024, Shopfully joined forces with the North American company Flipp, creating a global leader in the sector. Together, we reach 400 million households and serve over 1,000 top retailers and brands across 27 markets, including Europe, Canada, the USA, Latin America, and Australia.

Ready to spark
your growth with us?

We are the platform turning browsing into shopping
. We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands. We help consumers save time and money while making smart shopping decisions, and we support retailers and brands in engaging customers from online research to in-store purchases.

Ready to spark
your growth with us? 🚀

Who We Look For 🦄

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst
to join our Data Analytics team.

In this role, you’ll act as a key partner for Product, Data, and Business teams, leading measurement strategies and analytical initiatives to uncover insights that drive strategic and operational decisions.

You’ll work cross-functionally to transform complex data into clear narratives that demonstrate the value of our products and guide smarter business choices.

If you thrive on solving complex analytical problems, enjoy turning data into impactful stories, and love collaborating across teams, this role is for you!

What You Will Do 🏄

Partner with internal stakeholders to identify business questions and translate them into analytical solutions.
Translate product requirements into clear data requirements, ensuring data and analytics solutions align with business objectives and product goals.
Develop measurement strategies, frameworks, and KPIs to evaluate product and business performance.
Design and build dashboards and analytical tools to monitor key initiatives and enable data-driven decision-making.
Conduct impact analyses and A/B tests to validate hypotheses and optimize outcomes.
Deliver compelling data stories through reports, visualizations, and presentations.
Demonstrate the value of Flipp’s products and channels through performance tracking and insight storytelling.
Coach and support analysts, fostering best practices in analytical thinking and communication.

What You Will Need 🪄

5+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or Analytics Lead.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail.
Strong SQL skills and working knowledge of Python or R for data analysis.
Advanced knowledge of data visualization and BI tools (e.g. ThoughtSpot, Looker, Power BI, or Tableau).
Familiarity with modern data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, or similar).
Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g. LLMs, prompt engineering) to automate and improve analytical workflows.
Strong data acumen and the ability to grasp complex data concepts, enabling effective collaboration with technical teams on analytics infrastructure and data pipelines.
Solid understanding of statistics and experimentation methodologies.
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate data into business narratives.
Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and influence decisions through insights.
A growth mindset and passion for continuous learning.

👉 At our company, we value diversity and actively encourage it — we believe a variety of perspectives and backgrounds makes us stronger. We focus on potential rather than on having a “perfect” CV. If this role excites you and you believe you could grow into it — even if you don’t tick every single box in the requirements — we’d love to hear from you!

LOCATION 🌐

While we have an office in Milan, you can benefit from our flexible hybrid model (full-remote available from Italy), empowering you to work where you're most effective. Shopfully
and Flipp
, a leading Canadian company, are part of the same group: you’ll be hired in Europe while working directly within Flipp’s organization, in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

Since you’ll be collaborating with colleagues across different time zones, a bit of schedule flexibility will help you stay connected with our amazing teams in Canada!

If you’re excited about joining a dynamic, international team, working on cutting-edge projects and expanding your career globally, we’d love to hear from you! 💪🚀

What You Will Find At Shopfully 🤗

🌎 An opportunity to thrive in a rapidly scaling multinational company

🕶️ A vibrant, informal, and inclusive work environment

🧠 We champion autonomy, flexibility, and a hybrid work model, empowering you to own your work

📚 Access to learning opportunities and regular feedback sessions

🍓 Enjoy our central, modern offices featuring fresh snacks, coffee (including vegan options!), and ergonomic setups

🎉 Engage in meaningful team events: offsites, happy hours, company parties and celebrations that unite us beyond daily tasks

💻We provide all the necessary equipment for you to work effectively and set up your workspace, wherever you are

🧰 Benefit from additional country-specific advantages based on local contracts and practices

Who We Are 💜

We’re a team of 450 people (and counting!), from 30 different nationalities. We’re on a mission to innovate, and we believe the key to that is seeing the world through a variety of perspectives. That’s why building a more diverse team, as well as bringing in even more talent, is so important for us.

TO FEEL AT HOME 🛋️ IN SHOPFULLY YOU NEED 🎯

Progress Over Perfection: We move forward. Always. In a fast-moving world, speed with purpose beats certainty without action. Momentum matters—not for its own sake, but because it drives results.
Clarity Through Transparency: We bring each other along. We work in teams, not silos. Transparency gives context, and context enables action. That means we share decisions early, publish work in progress, and document outcomes so others can learn, move faster, and build better.
Learn Loudly: We grow by doing and by daring. Big bets unlock big breakthroughs. But real innovation demands risk, and risk always carries the possibility of failure. That’s not a flaw. It’s the price of ambition.
Challenge with Empathy: We speak up, even when it’s hard—because candor shows care, and leads to better outcomes. Listening deeply is how we grow. Disagreeing openly is how we build trust.
Always Build Better: We are builders—of products, systems, and ideas. But more than that, we are builders of better. Better has no finish line. It’s a mindset.

new_jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst, Enterprise
new_jobs.description:
1Password is growing.
We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to be a key analytical partner to our Customer Success organization and our product-led, digital customer journey. You’ll shape how the business understands what drives adoption, retention, and expansion, analyzing how customers move from sign-up to activation, engagement, conversion, expansion, and renewal, and turning that into clear, actionable insight on the growth levers leadership can act on. Sitting within our centralized analytics function, you’ll work closely with Customer Success, Product, Growth, RevOps, and Data Engineering, bringing strategic thinking, deep PLG expertise, and the ability to turn complex data into clear recommendations that move the business forward. You’ll help define how digital and scaled success programs are measured, size opportunities, show where to invest next, and help shape the data foundations that underpin our AI and automation capabilities.

How We’re Using AI Today

On the Analytics team, we're thoughtfully embedding AI into how we work with data. That looks like using AI to accelerate SQL development, pressure-test interpretations, turn complex datasets into clear executive narratives, and increasingly, building Generative BI applications that let stakeholders explore and interrogate data on their own. We approach AI the same way we approach data quality: with clear standards, human accountability at every consequential decision, and a commitment to getting it right before it influences the business. Beyond our own workflows, our role is evolving to ensure 1Password has the data foundations, governance, and structure its broader AI transformation depends on.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What We're Looking For

5+ years in analytics within complex B2B SaaS environments, ideally in a product-led or self-serve motion. B2C or hybrid B2B/B2C experience is a plus
Strong PLG and customer lifecycle expertise, including activation, PQLs, cohort analysis, retention, churn, expansion, and growth modeling
Experience partnering with Customer Success, Product, and Growth stakeholders and translating open-ended business questions into analytical frameworks
Ability to synthesize complex analysis into clear recommendations and communicate them to senior leaders, influencing decisions and priorities
Experience with experimentation (A/B testing), statistical modeling, or predictive techniques (e.g., churn or propensity modeling) in a business context
Advanced SQL and strong experience with large-scale analytical datasets, including product usage and event data
Hands-on experience with modern AI/BI tools (Hex, Omni, Claude, Dust, or similar)
Comfort in modern cloud data ecosystems: Snowflake, Databricks, dbt
Experience working with GTM and customer platforms such as Salesforce and a CS platform (Gainsight, or similar). Familiarity with product analytics tools (Amplitude, Segment, or similar) is a plus

What You Can Expect

The opportunity to do meaningful analytics work across adoption, retention, expansion, and digital success in a fast-moving, product-led SaaS environment
Close partnership with Customer Success stakeholders and a direct line to leadership on the growth levers that matter most, contributing to how the organization measures performance and makes day-to-day decisions
Involvement in building the data foundations and analytical standards that Customer Success and 1Password’s broader AI capabilities will depend on
Exposure to how AI gets applied in customer analytics, including Generative BI and AI-assisted workflows across forecasting, anomaly detection, and insight generation
Cross-functional collaboration across Customer Success, Product, Growth, Marketing, Finance, RevOps, and Data teams
An environment where there’s a lot to build and your contributions will have real impact, ideal for someone who is eager to grow, take ownership, and make their mark

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $122,000 USD and $171,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $105,000 CAD and $147,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Our culture

At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone . Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How We Work With AI

We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to be a key analytical partner to our Customer Success organization and our product-led, digital customer journey. That looks like using AI to accelerate SQL development, pressure-test interpretations, turn complex datasets into clear executive narratives, and increasingly, building Generative BI applications that let stakeholders explore and interrogate data on their own. We approach AI the same way we approach data quality: with clear standards, human accountability at every consequential decision, and a commitment to getting it right before it influences the business. Beyond our own workflows, our role is evolving to ensure 1Password has the data foundations, governance, and structure its broader AI transformation depends on.

About The Position

The Data Analyst is responsible for assisting with clinical data management. This position will support the coordination of multi-site study protocols through data extraction and statistical analysis, data cleaning and quality control, data transfers and merging of files, data queries, ad-hoc reports, and agreement execution. This position works cross-organizationally to ensure data quality, report real-time data for investigators and staff, and document standard operating procedures.

About The Project

The Data Analyst will support the Walter Reed Army Institute of Research (WRAIR) Medical Readiness Systems Biology Division in a multi-task research program focused on developing objective, integrated tools to assess physiological and psychological readiness in Service Members. The analyst will support data processing, management, quality assurance, and analysis across four research tasks involving biomarker discovery, wearable and handheld biosensors, gamified fatigue assessment, and resilience training evaluation. Working with The Geneva Foundation’s scientific and technical teams, the Data Analyst will help ensure accurate, reliable, and well-organized research data to support study execution, evaluate outcomes, and advance the development of evidence-based tools for assessing military readiness.

Prepare animal and human use protocols

Knowledge of military system, preferred.
Expertise in writing and executing code in Python and/or MATLAB required
Demonstrate competence in oral and written communication

new_jobs.description:
Southern Nuclear

Job Description

PMO Business Intelligence & Project Performance Analyst

This position may be based in Birmingham, Alabama, or at an SNC nuclear plant—Farley, Hatch, or Vogtle.

Job Summary

Southern Nuclear Operating Company (SNC) operates one of the nation's most respected nuclear generating fleets. The Project Management Office (PMO) provides fleet-level governance, project oversight, performance management, and reporting to support informed decision-making across the enterprise.

The PMO Business Intelligence & Project Performance Analyst develops reporting solutions, dashboards, scorecards, and analytics that provide visibility into project and portfolio performance. Partnering with project management, project controls, finance, engineering, information technology, and site leadership, this role improves data reliability, reporting efficiency, and decision quality by defining meaningful performance measures, identifying trends and risks, and translating complex cost, schedule, financial, resource, and strategic investment data into actionable insights.

Job Requirements

Education

Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline is required.
Advanced degree or relevant certification, such as Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst, Certified Analytics Professional, PMP, or PMI-PBA, is preferred.

Experience

At least five years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, financial analysis, performance reporting, or a related discipline is required.
Experience in project controls or project management, particularly within large-scale project organizations, project portfolios, capital programs, or complex multidisciplinary project environments, is a plus.
Experience developing Power BI dashboards, executive scorecards, data visualizations, KPIs, and automated reporting solutions is required.
Experience analyzing project cost, schedule, forecast, earned value, risk, resource utilization, and portfolio performance data is preferred.
Experience consolidating and validating data from multiple projects, sites, business units, or enterprise systems is preferred.
Experience with Power BI and Microsoft Excel is required. Experience with SharePoint, Primavera P6, SAP, Microsoft Project, SQL, or comparable project reporting and data platforms is a plus.
Experience supporting a PMO, Finance, or enterprise reporting organization is a plus.
Experience in a utility environment, including nuclear, electric generation, transmission, distribution, or related infrastructure, is a plus.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Advanced proficiency with Power BI, including data modeling, DAX, Power Query, report development, and dashboard design.
Advanced Excel skills and working knowledge of data integration, validation, governance, and reporting controls.
Familiarity with project management and project controls concepts, including project lifecycle management, stage-gate processes, governance, portfolio management, budgeting, forecasting, integrated scheduling, change control, risk management, earned value, and performance measurement.
Ability to translate business requirements into clear report specifications, metric definitions, data models, dashboards, and acceptance criteria.
Ability to interpret performance data, identify trends and root causes, and provide actionable recommendations.
Ability to communicate complex analytical findings through clear visualizations, executive narratives, presentations, and performance reviews.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and handle sensitive information appropriately.
Ability to travel among SNC sites and maintain unescorted access to SNC facilities.

Primary Responsibilities

Develop, maintain, and enhance Power BI dashboards, executive scorecards, KPIs, and project performance reports.
Analyze project and portfolio performance across cost, schedule, forecast, risk, resource utilization, earned value, and financial results.
Develop analytical insights and forecasting information that support executive decision-making, portfolio health assessments, and project prioritization.
Validate and reconcile data; document metric logic, data lineage, and business rules; and ensure reporting accuracy and traceability.
Partner with business and technical stakeholders to gather and define reporting requirements, data ownership, validation controls, and acceptance criteria.
Automate reporting processes to reduce manual effort and improve consistency, reliability, and efficiency.
Prepare executive-level reports, presentations, analytical summaries, and recommendations for leadership.
Support PMO governance metrics and reporting for project reviews, portfolio reviews, monthly reporting cycles, organizational performance management, data governance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Provide guidance and training to report users and promote consistent interpretation of project performance metrics.
Manage reporting solutions through requirements gathering and definition, design, testing, deployment, documentation, user adoption, and ongoing maintenance.
Evaluate emerging analytics, automation, and artificial intelligence capabilities that improve reporting efficiency, data reliability, and project performance visibility.

BEHAVIORAL ATTRIBUTES

Demonstrates Our Values: Safety First, Unquestionable Trust, Superior Performance, and Total Commitment.
Acts with integrity, professionalism, accountability, and a commitment to data quality.
Builds effective relationships, communicates clearly, and collaborates across organizational boundaries.
Demonstrates intellectual curiosity, initiative, adaptability, and a results -oriented mindset.

PLEASE NOTE

This position may require successful completion of applicable SNC training and qualification requirements as a condition of continued employment.

Southern Nuclear
, a subsidiary of Southern Company (NYSE: SO), is a leader among the nation’s nuclear energy facility operators and an innovator in advanced nuclear technologies. Southern Nuclear is an essential part of Southern Company’s energy portfolio, operating over 8,200 MW across eight nuclear energy units in Alabama and Georgia at the Joseph M. Farley Nuclear Plant near Dothan, Ala., the Edwin I. Hatch Nuclear Plant near Baxley, Ga., and the Alvin W. Vogtle Electric Generating Plant near Waynesboro, Ga.

The company recently achieved commercial operation on Vogtle Units 3&4, representing an historic achievement for the nuclear industry and the country. Vogtle Units 3&4 are the first new nuclear units to reach commercial operation and be built in the United States in the last three decades. Southern Nuclear is a recognized leader in the industry in nuclear and fuel innovation, having been the first to deploy Accident Tolerant Fuels and winning over 10 consecutive Top Innovative Practice (TIP) Awards and eight EPRI awards.

For more than 40 years, Southern Nuclear has operated nuclear energy facilities at the highest levels of safety and reliability, generating carbon-free electricity for millions of homes and businesses. The company’s headquarters is in Birmingham, Ala.

About Us

At BGBx
, we're driven by a simple idea: breakthrough thinking creates breakthrough impact. As an independent commercial solutions partner to pharmaceutical and life science companies, we bring together strategists, scientists, communicators, creatives, technologists, and data experts to tackle some of healthcare's most important challenges.

Our teams work across consulting and communications to help clients shape strategy, launch innovations, engage stakeholders, and drive meaningful results throughout the product lifecycle. The work is complex, fast-moving, and deeply connected to improving lives, creating opportunities for curious minds to make a real difference every day.

If you're energized by collaboration, inspired by innovation, and motivated by work that matters, you'll find a place to grow, contribute, and make a meaningful impact at BGBx.

Position Overview

The Senior Project Manager, Commercial Strategy & Innovation will serve as a strategic and operational partner to the Chief of Commercial Strategy & Innovation. This role will bring structure, organization, and proactive follow-through to cross-BGBx growth efforts across Consulting, Communications, Medical Communications, Payer, Data, AI, and Technology. This role will coordinate the people, materials, decisions, and follow-through required to move integrated client solutions and cross-planning forward. This is a hands-on senior project manager and strategic operations role that combines account planning, meeting and calendar management, pipeline coordination, leadership preparation, and cross-functional execution.

Responsibilities

Coordinate cross-BGBx account planning for priority pharmaceutical clients, including top-to-top meetings, QBRs, client touchpoints, follow-ups, and cross-planning.
Manage the head of Commercial Strategy & Innovation’s calendar and the logistics for key leadership and client activities, using business context to prioritize time, ensure the right participants are included, prepare, agendas and materials, and meetings drive to clear decisions and next steps.
Maintain a forward-looking view of account priorities, client milestones, proposal deadlines, leadership meetings, and cross-solving activity.
Track the enterprise pipeline, account plans, opportunity stages, owners, next actions, follow-ups, and available revenue attribution across priority accounts; maintain visibility and accountability without owning revenue decisions
Proactively identify gaps, conflicts, stalled opportunities, missing owners, and decisions that require escalation.
Build a working understanding of BGBx’s capabilities and know which relationship executives, capability experts, solution leads, and delivery teams to pull in, and when, based on client needs and opportunity requirements. Support IxI and Commercial Strategy revenue BLT reporting by coordinating inputs from cross-functional teams, tracking opportunities, owners, next steps, and available revenue attribution, and helping maintain visibility and accountability without owning revenue targets, revenue decisions, or attribution.
Prepare internal stakeholders for strategic meetings by developing agendas, briefing materials, late-breaking account updates, presentations, and support stakeholders with recommended next steps and follow-through.
Support the execution and coordination of repeatable account-planning tools, proposal processes, handoff workflows, governance models, and performance-tracking systems.
Coordinate follow-through after meetings and governance forums, ensuring that commitments are documented, owners are clear, and actions progress to completion.

What Makes The Role Distinctive

This role sits at the intersection of strategic project management and execution. The successful candidate will help BGBx leaders make better use of their time, stay aligned across divisions, and turn cross-BGBx conversations into organized, accountable action
The role is well suited to a highly organized, proactive, and strategic project manager who is comfortable managing details while understanding the broader business objective. This person should be able to move between calendar coordination, pipeline tracking, senior leadership preparation, executive content development, and cross-functional problem-solving.

Ideal candidate profile

Strong organizational and project-management skills, with exceptional attention to detail and follow-through.
Ready to dive in, roll-up-sleeves, diligent, real-time senior meeting mapping, scheduling and actions post client meetings
Proactive working style, with the judgment to anticipate needs, surface issues, and move work forward without constant direction.
Strategic thinker who can connect individual meetings and opportunities to broader account and enterprise-growth objectives.
Comfortable working across senior leaders, client teams, and multiple BGBx practice areas.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including demonstrated ability to draft, synthesize, and refine executive-ready presentations, briefing materials, account updates and other content
5 years of experience in Project management, strategic operations, account management, or a related field with demonstrated independence in complex, senior stakeholder environments
An MBA or equivalent business experience is preferred.

$90,000 - $120,000

For candidates located outside the New York City area, compensation will be adjusted to reflect the applicable market for the employee’s primary work location. Final compensation will be determined based on geographic location, experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

This is a highly technical program leadership role positioned at the intersection of  data center construction, commissioning, controls engineering, operational technology, networking, cybersecurity, facility operations, and OEM/vendor management
.

The Technical Program Manager will coordinate activities across construction teams, commissioning organizations, data center operations, controls and automation teams, OEMs, system integrators, network teams, cybersecurity specialists, and independent Cybersecurity Commissioning Agents.

. This is not a general administrative project-management position.

Program & Multi-Site Delivery Management
Lead technical program coordination across multiple concurrent data center projects.
Align all sites with integrated program plans covering cybersecurity verification and validation, construction, commissioning, operational readiness, and technical dependencies.
Coordinate activities across multiple geographic regions, sites, delivery teams, and Cybersecurity commissioning agents.
Maintain visibility of site readiness, schedules, dependencies, risks, constraints, and required technical resources.
Maintain program-level schedule, effort, resource utilization, budget, and financial health tracking.
Own and coordinate program and site-level prerequisites required for successful execution.
Develop standardized governance and execution processes that can scale across a large multi-site portfolio.
Coordinate work allocation and execution across multiple cybersecurity assurance vendors while maintaining consistent program expectations.
Construction & Commissioning Integration
Integrate cybersecurity V&V activities into the overall data center construction and commissioning lifecycle.
Understand and coordinate dependencies between construction completion, equipment installation, controls integration, functional testing, commissioning, and cybersecurity validation.
Work with General Contractors, commissioning teams, system integrators, technical PMOs, and site teams to determine when systems are sufficiently ready for cybersecurity activities.
Prevent premature mobilization by establishing clear technical and operational readiness criteria.
Coordinate cybersecurity activities around critical project milestones without unnecessarily affecting construction or commissioning progress.
Controls / Data Center Engineering / OT Systems Coordination

Provide technical coordination across data center control and monitoring environments, including systems such as:

Building Management Systems (BMS)
Power Management Systems (PMS)
SCADA
DCS and industrial control platforms
PLCs and industrial controllers
RTUs, gateways, meters, relays, and IEDs
EPMS and electrical monitoring systems
Environmental and mechanical controls
Industrial networking infrastructure
Engineering workstations and management platforms
Associated servers, applications, interfaces, and communications infrastructure
Maintain sufficient technical knowledge of controls and OT platforms to understand system architecture, ownership, technical dependencies, testing prerequisites, and escalation requirements.
4. Data Center Operations Integration
Establish strong coordination between project delivery teams and Data Center Operations.
Ensure cybersecurity verification activities consider operational constraints and production-readiness requirements.
Coordinate technical handover requirements between construction/commissioning teams and operations.
Track ownership of systems, credentials, documentation, configurations, software, and technical artifacts necessary for validation.
Help resolve gaps between global program objectives and actual site execution conditions.
OEM, Vendor & System Integrator Coordination
Serve as the program-level coordination point for OEMs, system integrators, contractors, controls vendors, and Cybersecurity Commissioning Agent organizations.
Identify the correct technical owner for equipment and systems requiring verification.
Coordinate vendor availability during testing windows.
Ensure required engineering software, documentation, configurations, credentials, access, technical SMEs, and testing support are available.
Escalate unresolved vendor or technical dependencies before they affect execution.
Coordinate common requirements across OEMs rather than repeatedly resolving the same issues independently at each site.
Technical Logistics & Readiness

Own The Technical-readiness Process Covering

Site access
Assessment workstations
Network connectivity
Engineering system access
Required documentation
Network and controls architecture
Asset inventories
Configuration documentation
OEM technical resources
System integrator resources
Cybersecurity commissioning agent requirements
Testing windows
Evidence collection
Technical repositories
Finding and workflow-management systems

Establish a formal  readiness gate
 before site mobilization.

Cybersecurity Verification & Validation Program Coordination
Coordinate execution between program stakeholders and independent Cybersecurity Commissioning Agents.
Translate program objectives into executable site-level technical activities.
Maintain consistent V&V expectations, evidence requirements, acceptance criteria, and reporting across multiple providers.
Coordinate testing activities involving OT devices, controls platforms, industrial networks, applications, and supporting infrastructure.
Track systemic findings and recurring issues across the portfolio.
Facilitate escalation of findings requiring program-level rather than site-level resolution.
Support integration of lessons learned into future design, procurement, commissioning, and operational requirements.
Program Governance & Reporting
Maintain integrated RAID logs covering risks, actions, issues, dependencies, and decisions.
Develop program dashboards covering readiness, execution status, testing progress, findings, dependencies, and blockers.
Facilitate technical program reviews and readiness meetings.
Maintain clear RACI across site teams, operations, controls teams, OEMs, integrators, Cybersecurity Commissioning Agents, and other stakeholders.
Escalate systemic issues requiring enterprise or program-level decisions.
Drive consistent methods across sites while accommodating genuine technical differences between facilities.

Supervisory Responsibilities

None

Skills

The requirements listed below are representative of acquired skills required.

Candidates must demonstrate relevant experience across all of the following areas. These requirements represent the core technical and program-management capabilities necessary for the role.

Data Center Experience

Significant experience delivering technical programs within hyperscale, colocation, mission-critical, or similarly complex data center environments.
Demonstrated understanding of data center construction, commissioning, operational readiness, and handover.

Construction Experience

Demonstrated experience working within major construction or infrastructure delivery programs.
Strong understanding of construction schedules, contractor dependencies, site readiness, commissioning gates, and project controls.

Controls / OT Experience

Strong working knowledge of building automation, industrial control, power-management, SCADA/DCS, PLC, and related cyber-physical systems.
Ability to interpret controls architecture, network diagrams, system interfaces, and technical dependencies.

Networking Experience

Working understanding of:

TCP/IP
VLANs
Routing and switching
Firewalls
Network segmentation
Industrial Ethernet
Remote access
IT/OT integration

Demonstrated ability to engage effectively understand and interact with network engineering teams on architecture, segmentation, routing, switching, firewall, remote-access, and IT/OT integration requirements.

Cybersecurity Experience

Experience leading or coordinating cybersecurity programs involving OT, industrial systems, critical infrastructure, or cyber-physical systems.
Understanding of cybersecurity verification, validation, assessment, risk management, remediation, and technical assurance.

About The Role

Simon & Schuster, one of the world's leading publishers, is investing in a multi-year modernization of the core systems that power order management, fulfillment, partner integration, and financial transactions. We are replacing long-established technology with modern .NET and SQL solutions using an AI-assisted approach.

The Technical Business Analyst connects business needs with hands-on data investigation. You will map processes, clarify requirements, and translate legacy behavior into specifications and acceptance criteria that developers can implement. Strong SQL skills are central to the role: you will compare existing and replacement outputs, explain differences, and help business users validate results before production cutover.

You will own comparison rules, test data, first-pass reconciliation, and validation evidence, working with developers who own the automation framework and application implementation. This is a technical analysis role with targeted business and data validation, not a dedicated test-automation engineering position.

Validate reports and interfaces — Check calculations, totals, completeness, and exchanged data against agreed requirements; provide reproducible findings and follow issues through retesting.
Coordinate UAT and cutover evidence — Organize business testing, maintain requirements-to-test traceability, and summarize results and unresolved issues so business owners can make informed acceptance decisions.

The Company

The energy industry is entering one of the most significant periods of growth and transformation in its history. Meeting the nation’s growing demand for reliable electricity will require new ideas, new infrastructure, and talented people committed to building for the future.
At Cypress Creek Energy, we’re meeting that challenge by developing and operating the energy infrastructure needed to power communities, support economic opportunity, and strengthen resilience. We believe our responsibility extends beyond the grid and that how we build matters just as much as what we build.

Overview

In collaboration with the Senior Director of Project Management, the Project Manager/Senior Project Manager will broadly serve as the overall point of contact and subject matter expert for a rolling portfolio of projects. The Project Manager/Senior Project Manager will work collaboratively with Business Development and Pre-Construction to support construction due diligence, including constructability reviews, risk analyses, developing project schedules, reviewing budgets and CAPEX estimates, and analyses of EPC RFP's, in support of construction projects. The Project Manager will provide tactical leadership for construction, assist in the development of strategic project objectives, provide direction for projects from late-stage development through the final construction phase, lead the management of construction contracts to ensure projects are on time and within budget, and ensure that safety, quality, cost, environmental, landowner, and legal requirements are properly addressed to support the project execution objectives.

Participate in a formal turnover and acceptance of the project from Pre-Construction to Project Execution and turnover to Asset Management / O&M

Provide leadership during project construction activities, ensuring safety, quality, schedule, cost, environmental, landowner, and other project requirements are met or exceeded
Understand and manage all aspects of project construction contracts (EPC, Owner-Furnished Equipment, Interconnection Agreement, technical consultants) and hold the contractors and suppliers accountable to contractual requirements to ensure projects are completed on time and under budget

Champion change and effectively manage the implementation of new ideas, processes, tools, etc.

Additional duties as required

Minimum of a bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management or related field.
Project Management Professional certification a plus

Advanced knowledge of construction management and constructing methods for large projects, contract management, procurement, and supply chain management, environmental and building permitting, and transportation logistics
Basic knowledge of construction labor relations throughout the US
Competency in analytical problem solving, customer/partner relationships, and technology expertise.
Proficient understanding of entire solar project life cycle
Experience with High Voltage Interconnection aspects of a project’s scope of work.
Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office (i.e. Word, Project, Excel, PowerBI), Procore, SiteTracker, NetSuite and other discipline-relevant software.

Self-motivated, capable of performing tasks with minimal supervision.
Ability to work well in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and meet deadlines.
Strong organizational skills and multitasking ability.
Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
Effective communication skills, both written and verbal.
Commitment to continuous improvement and analytical problem-solving.
Ability to create and implement programs/policies involving multiple departments.
Embrace and live by the mission and values of Cypress Creek Energy

In-office, full remote, or hybrid employment will be considered.
Must hold a valid driver’s license

new_jobs.title: Information Security Manager
new_jobs.description:
The Company

The energy industry is entering one of the most significant periods of growth and transformation in its history. Meeting the nation’s growing demand for reliable electricity will require new ideas, new infrastructure, and talented people committed to building for the future.

At Cypress Creek Energy, we’re meeting that challenge by developing and operating the energy infrastructure needed to power communities, support economic opportunity, and strengthen resilience. We believe our responsibility extends beyond the grid and that how we build matters just as much as what we build.

That same commitment extends to our employees. We invest in professional growth, encourage collaboration across teams, and provide opportunities to take ownership, expand your expertise, and advance your career. Our culture is grounded in safety, accountability, respect, and a shared commitment to deliver results. Join us and help meet one of the most important energy challenges of our time while building a rewarding career.

Overview

Cypress Creek Energy is hiring an Information Security Manager to lead the company's security operations and compliance program. This is a hands-on individual contributor role designed for a senior technical security professional ready to take ownership of a complete program — with the opportunity to grow into a leader of a team as the function scales.

The successful candidate brings a balance of deep technical execution and program-level compliance maturity. You will own the day-to-day security tooling stack, lead the company's NIST-based compliance program, shape policy in emerging areas including artificial intelligence, and maintain an accurate view of every system in the environment. You will report directly to the Chief Technology Officer and partner closely with IT, Counsels, and business stakeholders across the company.

Responsibilities

Security Operations & Engineering
Endpoint security: Administer and tune Microsoft Defender across the endpoint estate, including policy configuration, alert triage, response, and reporting.
Network and access security: Manage the Zscaler platform (ZIA/ZPA), including policy development, traffic inspection, access controls, and integration with identity systems.
SIEM operations: Own SIEM tuning, detection engineering, log source onboarding, alerting, and incident workflows. Build dashboards and metrics that surface meaningful signals.
Vulnerability management: Run the vulnerability scanning program across AWS and Azure cloud environments and on-premises infrastructure. Prioritize, track, and verify remediation in partnership with IT and engineering teams.
Patch management: Maintain endpoint patching cadence and reporting, ensuring coverage, exception tracking, and SLA adherence.
Digital forensics & incident response: Lead investigations into security events, perform forensic analysis, document findings, and coordinate response with internal teams and external partners as needed.

Compliance & Governance
NIST-based program: Maintain and continuously improve the company's NIST Cybersecurity Framework-aligned security program, including controls mapping, evidence collection, and gap remediation.
Policy management: Own the security policy library — ensure policies and standards are current, reviewed on a defined cadence, approved through the right channels, and communicated to the business.
AI policy and guidance: Develop and maintain the company's AI usage policies, acceptable use guidance, and review process for new AI tools, in coordination with Counsels and IT.
System inventory: Build and maintain an authoritative inventory of systems, applications, data flows, and ownership. Keep it accurate as the environment evolves.
Audit and assessment support: Lead responses to internal and external audits, customer security reviews, and regulatory inquiries. Manage remediation of identified findings through closure.
Risk management: Identify, document, and track information security risks; propose mitigations and report on residual risk to leadership.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership
Stakeholder engagement: Partner with IT, Counsels, HR, and business leaders on security matters, providing clear guidance that balances risk with business needs.
Operational Technology (OT): Act as a partner and advisor to the OT team coordinating security and compliance initiatives across the company. Manage intersection of IT and OT endpoints, systems, and networks.
Security awareness: Drive the security awareness program, including phishing simulations, training content, and ongoing communications.
Vendor and third-party risk: Assess and manage security risk associated with vendors, contractors, and third-party service providers.
Future team leadership: Lay the groundwork to scale the function. As the program matures, hire, mentor, and lead a team of security professionals.

Education & Experience Required

Use of AI to enhance and scale security operations – establish AI first Security Ops
Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, cybersecurity, or related field — or equivalent professional experience.
5+ years of progressive experience in information security, with demonstrated depth in security operations, engineering, or a combination of both.
Hands-on administration and tuning experience with Microsoft Defender (Endpoint, Identity, Cloud).
Production experience operating Zscaler (ZIA and/or ZPA), including policy management and troubleshooting.
Strong SIEM experience — building detections, tuning alerts, investigating incidents, and onboarding log sources.
Vulnerability management experience across cloud environments, specifically AWS and Azure.
Working knowledge of digital forensics and incident response methodology.
Demonstrated experience operating a security program aligned to the NIST Cybersecurity Framework or NIST 800-53.
Track record of writing, maintaining, and operationalizing security policies and standards.
Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical risk to non-technical audiences.
Ability to work from the Durham, NC or Washington, DC office three days per week.
Embrace and live by the mission and values of Cypress Creek Energy

Preferred Qualifications

Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GIAC (GCIH, GCFA, GCIA), or equivalent.
Experience operating in the energy, utility, or critical infrastructure sector.
Familiarity with NERC CIP or other regulatory frameworks relevant to the power sector.
Experience scripting or automating security workflows (Python, PowerShell, KQL).
Prior experience as a senior technical lead preparing to step into a manager role.

Location:
The preferred location for this role is for our offices in Durham, NC and Washington, DC. Our team operates on a hybrid schedule, with in-office schedule of three days per week.

Compensation:
The salary range for the position is $140,000 - $155,000 plus bonus and benefits. Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location.

Benefits

15 days of Paid Time Off, accrual up to 20 days, 11 observed holidays.
401(k) Match
Comprehensive package including medical, dental, vision and health insurance
Wellness stipend, family planning stipend, and generous parental leave
Tuition Reimbursement
Phone Bill Reimbursement
Company Swag

The Human Resources team coordinates all recruiting and hiring at our company. We do not accept resumes from third-party recruiters unless authorized by the Human Resources team and if a signed agreement is in place. Any unsolicited resumes will be considered property of CCE and we are not responsible for any related fees. All communication related to recruiting partnerships should ONLY be directed to the Human Resources team.

Cypress Creek Energy is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status. We are committed to providing a workplace that is inclusive and values diversity, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Please be aware of recruiting scams—official communications will only come from @ccrenew.com, we will never request personal or financial information, and any suspicious activity should be reported to HR@ccrenew.com.

Title

Operations Program Analyst

At KBR, we deliver science, technology and engineering solutions to governments and companies around the world. KBR employs approximately 37,000 people worldwide with customers in more than 85 countries and operations in over 28 countries. KBR is proud to work with its customers across the globe to provide technology, value-added services, and long-term operations and maintenance services to ensure consistent delivery with predictable results.

Trinzic is the future independent company to be created through the planned spin-off of KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business, expected in January 2027. Our people work at the frontier of what is possible, delivering solutions in challenging environments and advancing some of the world's highest-priority national security and space missions. 

Backed by decades of mission success, deep expertise, and trusted partnerships, Trinzic will launch as a global organization with more than 18,000 employees supporting customers around the world. Join us at a defining moment and help shape the future of a company built to tackle complex challenges and make a meaningful impact. 

Candidates who join KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business before the spin-off will transition to Trinzic when the separation is complete and will not need to reapply for employment. 

Program Summary

KBR’s Mission Engineering Division delivers complex technical solutions and expert support to the U.S. Department of War, specializing in modeling and simulation, cyber transformation, air vehicle mission integration, and lifecycle support. As a trusted partner with a proven history in mission technology, KBR collaborates closely with clients to develop innovative and effective solutions. With a strong ethical framework, KBR prioritizes data security, privacy, and responsible information management to ensure mission success.

Job Summary

KBR is seeking an Operations Program Analyst to join our team supporting PMA-265 F/A-18 and EA-18G Weapons Systems Integration (WSI) integrated Product Team (IPT) at the Naval Air Systems Command (NAVAIRSYSCOM) at Patuxent River, MD. The selected candidate will provide direct business, acquisition, program management, technical service support, and day-to-day operations support.

The F/A-18 and EA-18G Program Office (PMA-265) provides critical current and future capabilities in the form of total life cycle support management (cradle to grave) for the F/A-18A-D Hornet, F/A-18E/F Super Hornet and EA-18G Growler weapons systems. PMA-265 is responsible for acquiring, delivering and sustaining the F/A-18 and EA-18G aircraft, ensuring mission success for U.S. Navy and Marine Corps aviators, as well as international partners to include Australia, Canada, Finland, Kuwait, Malaysia, Spain and Switzerland. Must be a self-starter who requires limited oversight. Strong organizational skills, communication and problem solving are a must. This is an “in office” only position with situational tele-work authorized some travel may be required.

Roles And Responsibilities

The Operations Program Analyst is responsible for coordinating Government/Contractor staffing requirements, responses to data drills, and technical evaluations between leadership, departments, and external partners to align goals and resolve operational issues while ensuring tasks are completed on or before due date.
Captures action items and meeting minutes to prepare program briefings, status reports, point papers, Requests for Information (RFIs) and other documentation as required. Tracking program status, evaluating operational and technical alternatives, developing and tracking responses to program office operations tasking, and liaising with Level III Product Leads for timely submission of requirements.
Supports developing plans including budgets and schedules to meet contractual/project requirements for the IPT programs. Makes recommendations in support of program execution, and out-year planning. Executes incoming drills and tasks from outside organizations and coordinates responses through OPS and PMA Leadership.
Supports analytic and process improvement techniques in the evaluation of program/project objectives. Analyzes requirements, status, budget and schedules. Performs management, technical, or business case analyses. Collects, completes, organizes and interprets data relating to aircraft/weapon/project acquisition and product programs. Tracks program/project status and schedules. Supports Government-instituted processes for documentation, change control management and data management.
