Required Experience: Journeyman - 3 to 10 years of combined experience performing duties described in the functional description.
Functional Description: Applies analytic techniques in the evaluation of program/project objectives. Analyzes requirements, status, budget and schedules. Performs management, technical, or business case analyses. Collects, completes, organizes and interprets data relating to aircraft/weapon/project acquisition and product programs. Tracks program/project status and schedules. Government-institute processes apply for documentation, change control management and data management.
Required Education: Journeyman - BA/BS degree.

Must be highly proficient Microsoft Office 365 (Word; Excel; PowerPoint; Outlook). Acquisitions Management System, and the Defense Travel System (DTS).

Preferred Qualifications

Desired Experience: 2 years of experience supporting NAVAIR

Work Location
: On-site required

$83,930.00 - $125,840.00. The salary range posted is for Maryland locations. The offered rate will be based on contract affordability, the selected candidate’s knowledge, skills, abilities, and/or experience, and in consideration of internal parity.

KBR offers a selection of competitive lifestyle benefits which could include a 401K plan with company match, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, AD&D, flexible spending account, disability, paid time off, or flexible work schedule. We support career advancement through professional training and development.

Belong, Connect and Grow at KBR

That commitment is central to our team of team’s philosophy and fosters an environment where everyone can Belong, Connect and Grow. We Deliver – Together.

new_jobs.description:
Senior Strategic Business Analyst – Human Capital Portfolio

Do you love to shape transformation needs into clear fundable decisions? Ready to help leaders track real value from Human Capital initiatives and close the gaps that matter fast!

This role can be based in the UK or US, with hybrid flexibility to work both virtually and from a local office in line with in-country smart working policy.

The Senior Strategic Business Analyst supports the Human Capital Portfolio Lead and Programme Managers in translating strategic priorities and stakeholder needs into robust, decision-ready investment proposals.

The role leads business analysis from ideation through to mobilisation, shaping complex business cases and CBAs, defining capability-aligned high-level requirements, and establishing how value will be measured and realised. As an advanced professional, the role works autonomously on complex issues, applies broad organisational understanding and sound judgement, and influences senior stakeholders to secure an agreed path forward.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organisation, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What The Day Will Look Like

Pipeline initiative co-ordination

Lead business stakeholders through VRO approval process, providing structure, challenge and guidance from the initial idea through investment decision.
Assess the strategic problem or opportunity, desired outcomes, scope, dependencies and delivery considerations.
Co-ordinate and review input from business, Finance, IT delivery and subject-matter experts to ensure complete, considered and timely movement through the process.
Review submissions for completeness, quality, strategic alignment, clear value realisation, operational and governance readiness.
Resolve ambiguity and reconcile competing stakeholder perspectives.

Business cases and investment analysis

Lead the development of compelling business cases and CBAs.
Evaluate strategic alignment, options, costs, benefits, risks, assumptions and delivery implications.
Construct evidence-based recommendations and explain the implications of proceeding, changing scope, delaying or taking no action.
Challenge assumptions and validate supporting evidence.
Prepare decision papers and presentations for senior governance forums.

Requirements And Capability Alignment

Facilitate discovery sessions to elicit business outcomes and high-level requirements.
Translate strategic needs into clear, prioritised and testable requirements without prescribing a technology solution.
Map requirements to Human Capital capabilities, operating-model components and portfolio priorities.
Maintain traceability between strategic objectives, capabilities, requirements, investment decisions and intended benefits.
Identify overlaps, gaps, dependencies and opportunities for reuse across the portfolio.
Facilitate hand off to product teams during mobilisation

Value realisation

Define measurable outcomes, benefit hypotheses, baselines, targets and success measures.
Agree benefit ownership and measurement approaches with business stakeholders.
Support Programme Managers in embedding value measures within programme plans and governance.
Review whether delivered outcomes remain aligned to the approved business case.
Provide insight into portfolio performance, risks and opportunities to improve value.

Stakeholder and portfolio support

Act as a trusted adviser to the Portfolio Lead, Programme Managers and senior business stakeholders.
Facilitate complex discussions and build agreement where priorities differ.
Connect related initiatives and highlight cross-portfolio impacts and dependencies.
Coach stakeholders and junior analysts in business-case, requirements and value-realisation practices.
Improve VRO templates, standards and guidance using lessons learned.

How This Opportunity Is Different

This role sits at the centre of Aon’s Human Capital transformation agenda. You’ll have visibility across a diverse portfolio of initiatives and direct exposure to senior governance forums, translating strategy into measurable outcomes and actionable, leadership-ready recommendations. You’ll collaborate closely with business leaders, product and programme teams and be supported by the Human Capital Portfolio Lead to strengthen investment decisions, improve adoption, and accelerate value realisation across the portfolio.

Skills And Experience That Will Lead To Success

Strong experience in business strategy, portfolio analysis, business analysis or organisational transformation.
Demonstrated experience leading complex business cases, CBAs or investment proposals.
Strong understanding of capability-based planning, requirements definition and benefits realisation.
Experience influencing senior stakeholders and facilitating decisions across multiple business areas.
Ability to interpret financial and non-financial evidence and convert it into concise recommendations.
Experience working with portfolio, programme or transformation governance.
Knowledge of Human Capital or People functions is desirable.
